description: Rothco's Stainless Steel Canteen Cup and Cover Set is the perfect addition to your camping gear, bug out bag, or outdoor cooking setup. Made from durable heavy gauge stainless steel, this canteen cup and cover set is built to withstand rugged use while ensuring your food and water stay fresh. The convenient lid helps retain heat and keep contents secure, making it ideal for both boiling water and cooking meals in the wild. The butterfly handle design provides a secure grip and easy handling, even when the cup is hot. Measuring 4 1/2 inches x 2 7/8 inches at the bottom, 5 1/4 inches x 3 1/4 inches at the top, and 3 3/4 inches in height, this versatile set is compact enough to carry in your pack yet spacious enough for your needs. Whether you're hiking, camping, or preparing for emergencies, Rothco's Stainless Steel Canteen Cup and Cover Set is a reliable and essential tool.
